description: Send the same text to one number every day, week or month at a local time (e.g. a weekly reminder). Every occurrence runs the usual send checks.

category.description: Optional. It can make each occurrence stricter (`marketing`), never looser: the sending number's registration and the wording decide ([which messages are marketing](/docs/compliance-checks#which-messages-are-marketing)).

end_date.description: Last local date it may run (inclusive).

from.description: One of your numbers. Optional when the account has exactly one number for the key's mode.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Retries are already safe: the same call with the same inputs within 10 minutes is done once and answers with the first result. Pass your own key to dedupe across a longer gap, or a new one to repeat an identical call on purpose.

max_occurrences.description: The schedule completes after this many messages have been sent.

quiet_hours.description: Optional. What to do with a message in the recipient's quiet hours: `block` refuses it (403 quiet_hours), `defer` holds it until their next 9:00am. Omitted: an occurrence in quiet hours is held until the recipient's 8:00am and recorded as `deferred`.

repeat.description: When it sends: how often, the local time and the time zone

day_of_month.description: Monthly only, required. Months without that day run on their last day.

start_date.description: First local date it may run. Defaults to today.
